framework_origin: cc-rsg 7-category Question Bank adapted for spec-anything

questions.question: Does CreateMemo honor `pinned: true` on initial creation or ignore it until UpdateMemo?
questions.resolution: Proto documentation (proto/api/memo_service.proto) and live runtime observation EV-006 both confirm `pinned` is ignored on creation and must be updated via PATCH /api/memos/{uid}?updateMask=pinned.

questions.question: Which endpoints remain anonymously accessible when an instance is initialized vs PRIVATE access mode?
questions.resolution: Single source of truth verified in server/api/acl_config.go (`PublicMethods` vs `AuthBootstrapMethods`); runtime confirmed via EV-003 and EV-009.

questions.question: Why does the official darwin_arm64 release binary report vcs.modified=true (+dirty) in Go buildinfo despite matching tag 26.11.2?
questions.resolution: Confirmed via .github/workflows/release.yml:84,121,139 and server/frontend/dist/index.html (244B placeholder in source): CI compiles web/ into server/frontend/dist before `go build`, dirtying the git worktree prior to //go:embed.

questions.question: How are SQL LIKE wildcard characters (`%`, `_`) handled inside CEL `content.contains(...)` filters on SQLite?
questions.resolution: Verified in filter/engine_test.go:176-181 and runtime observation EV-008: `%` and `_` are escaped with `ESCAPE '\'` so `50%_off` matches literally and never matches `50X_off`.

questions.question: What are exact runtime wire payloads for third-party OAuth2 SSO providers, S3 presigned uploads, SMTP notifications, and external AI providers?
questions.resolution: Marked abandoned for offline isolated verification; proto/Go contracts are code-verified only. Re-verify using local OAuth2 mock IdP, MinIO, and Mailpit test doubles.

questions.question: Are MySQL and PostgreSQL schema migration edge cases identical to SQLite under concurrent load?
questions.resolution: Marked abandoned for single-host SQLite baseline; MySQL/PostgreSQL parity requires dedicated container matrix verification.
